strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.Рязанская земля, межа Петровичей и Яруст: Ryazan land, the boundary of Petrovichi and Yarustovo
strings.муж князя Фёдора Васильевича Рязанского: man of Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich of Ryazan
strings.Назван в разъезжей грамоте 1483—1503 год: Named in a boundary charter of 1483–1503 as a participant in establishing a land boundary in the Ryazan land.
strings.Антипа — личное имя самого участника; Ан: Antipa is the personal name of the participant himself; Anfilogov syn is a direct patronymic from his father Anfilog; Feodotyevskoy is with high probability a local designation from the village of Fedotyevo, adjacent to the boundary.
strings.В полном тексте акта Антипа поставлен пе: In the full text of the act Antipa is placed first among the four «мужей» ["men"] of Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich of Ryazan at the official boundary survey, i.e. he belonged to the prince's service entourage; no separate rank is named.
strings.Разъезд отделял бортные земли княжеских: The survey separated the beekeeping (bort) lands of the prince's bort-keepers of Petrovichi from the bort-keepers of the Olgov monastery from Yarustovo; this is a concrete economic and service context, not a chance presence at a private transaction.
strings.Патроним прямо сохраняет имя его отца Ан: The patronymic directly preserves the name of his father Anfilog. Since Antipa was already an adult participant in the case, the father belongs to an earlier 15th-century generation; a separate cautious profile, P9681, has been created for him.
strings.Запись документирует переход от личного: The Record documents the transition from the personal name Anfilog to the designation of his son as «Анфилогов сын» ["Anfilog's son"] even before the first known record of the village of Onfilogovo.
strings.Петровичи и Ярустово разделяет около 5 к: Petrovichi and Yarustovo are about 5 km apart, and Fedotyevo lies roughly 9 km from both settlements. This is a specific micro-region of the middle Oka where the designation originated, but not a proven route of the family to Oryol.
strings.Связь семьи с Тверским уездом, Никольски: A connection of the family with Tver uyezd, Nikolskoye Svechino or the Yurlovs has not been established.
strings.Антипа — сам участник разъезда. Анфилого: Antipa is the participant in the survey himself. Anfilogov syn means that his father was called Anfilog; it is not a variant of Antipa's own name.
strings.Петровичи и Ярустово лежат рядом с сохра: Petrovichi and Yarustovo lie next to the surviving village of Fedotyevo. Therefore the additional form is with high probability a territorial designation — "a man from Feodotyevo". The act does not give a literal formula of residence, and the conclusion is left as probable.
strings.Антипа был взрослым служилым человеком н: Antipa was an adult serviceman no later than the beginning of the 16th century, so his father Anfilog belonged to the 15th century.
strings.Почему отец — отдельное историческое лиц: Why the father is a separate historical person
strings.Формула «Анфилогов сын» является прямым: The formula «Анфилогов сын» ["Anfilog's son"] is a direct patronymic, not an abstract similarity of sounds. It attests a real father of Antipa named Anfilog, although the father himself did not take part in the boundary survey.
strings.Полная публикация ставит Антипу первым с: The full publication places Antipa first among the four «мужей» ["men"] of Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich at the official survey between the prince's and the monastery's bort-keepers. This is a documented princely service milieu, although Antipa's specific rank is not named.
strings.Если взрослый сын Анфилога известен уже: If an adult son of Anfilog is already known between 1483 and 1503, the father himself lived early enough to have theoretically given his name to a settlement recorded in 1539/1540. The match of generation is important but does not replace a local connection.
strings.В акте нет Никольского Свечина, Юрловых,: The act does not mention Nikolskoye Svechino, the Yurlovs, Khorvach or the neighbouring villages in Tver.
strings.Это ранняя контрольная параллель и доказ: This is an early control parallel and a proven bearer of the patronymic, but not a Tver candidate: no landholding, resettlement or chain of kinship leading to Tver uyezd has been found.
strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII RAN), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.Между 1483 и 1503 годами Антипа, сын Анф: Between 1483 and 1503 Antipa, son of Anfilog, stood first among the four men of Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich at the survey of the bort lands of Petrovichi and Yarustovo.
strings.КТО И ЧТО РАЗМЕЖЕВЫВАЛ. Боярин и дворецк:
WHO DREW THE BOUNDARY AND OF WHAT. The boyar and majordomo (dvoretsky) Matvei Denisyevich Bulgak marked out the boundary between Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich's patrimonial bort land at Petrovichi and the bort-keepers of the Olgov monastery from Yarustovo. The document lists marshes, boundary marks, river bends, a road, a spring and lakes, i.e. it describes a real economic landscape of the middle Oka basin.

ANTIPA'S ROLE. In the concluding witness formula Antipa stands first among the four «мужей» ["men"] of Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich present at the survey. This is stronger than the earlier general description "the prince's man": he belonged to a service group of the prince's court at an official boundary survey. Anfilog himself does not take part in the event, but his name is reliably preserved by the direct patronymic of his adult son.

NEW MICRO-GEOGRAPHY. Petrovichi and Yarustovo survive in the Spassky district of Ryazan oblast; the distance between their present-day centres is about 5 km. In the same local cluster there is the old village of Fedotyevo: its centre lies about 9.29 km from Petrovichi and 8.80 km from Yarustovo. Therefore the form «Феодотьевской» ["Feodotyevskoy"] is with high probability a local designation of a man from Feodotyevo, not an abstract surname. For the first time this narrows the origin of Antipa and his father's family to a specific micro-region of the middle Oka.

LIMIT OF THE CONCLUSION. The act does not literally say "lived in Feodotyevo" and does not name the father's landholding. The localisation does not link the family with Oryol: between the adult Antipa of the late 15th century and the Oryol landholders of 1594/95 there remain two or three undocumented generations.
strings.Не установлены отчество и биография отца: The patronymic and biography of the father, Anfilog, have not been established.
strings.Проверить по оригиналу, является ли «Фео: Check against the original whether «Феодотьевской» ["Feodotyevskoy"] is a direct territorial designation or already a stable second name.
There is no connection with Oryol uyezd.
